segments.summary: Reviewed fail-closed allowlists and initialization, provider prompt parsing, Doctor checks, violation payloads, GUI metrics, and plan-file-list validation; identified parser/payload ambiguity and missing dashboard truth states.

Reviewed runtime profiles, launch metadata, BaseRunner and worktree ownership, orchestrator/interview seams, GUI config/event projection, and non-executable sequencing; profile/launch and GUI lifecycle semantics remain incomplete.

Reviewed Settings and Assistant Chat recovery guidance, Prompt Pipeline ownership, risk metadata, blocked taxonomy, payload fields, and UI action projection; found missing UI state transitions and a payload spelling/action-mapping seam.

Reviewed account-pressure preservation, bulk recovery preview constraints, analytics events, safe-point interaction, blocked acceptance, denial classification, and rollback-before-retry; schema, privacy, target revalidation, and preservation predicates remain open.

Reviewed blocked payload and action canon, retired field names, child/run identity, restore-only rerun, and persistent episode reconstruction; action eligibility/persistence and concurrency-safe episode resolution are underspecified.

Reviewed retired bridge lineage, shared mutation-session guards, safe-point receipts, planning source-control safety, non-Git/remote handling, and no-leak discovery; executable schemas/oracles and planning setup boundaries remain incomplete.

Reviewed vision source ingestion, Free Models adapter side effects, container host guards, and credential redaction timing; permission/quarantine lifecycles and the end-to-end redaction barrier remain unresolved.

Reviewed trace and log redaction, observability quotas/sampling, filesystem regression coverage, fail-closed repair, and final deferred notes; debug capture and observability remain critical gaps, while F2-199 is concrete.
